board_revision_and_electrical_verified.evidence: board_confirmation.json: user identifies IWR6843ISK PROC073REVD and Milianke F20, supplied fixed LVDS mapping and restored original adapter; user explicitly confirms S1.5 ON and HDR1 1V8/1-2. Reviewed board_io_contract.md and Rev D schematic show Bank44 3.3V and Bank65 internal 100ohm termination with no parallel shunt in supplied adapter/TI path. Acceptance is bounded to this bounded finite-frame experiment with unchanged wiring; no meter/waveform measurement claimed.

actual_flashed_firmware_matches_file.evidence: flash/20261030_program_01: known SHA-256 image programmed as META_IMAGE1 by native UniFlash, exit 0; ROM final CLOSE GET STATUS 0x40 with valid response checksum; subsequent functional boot reports SDK 03.05.00.04/IWR68XX. No independent bitwise readback; original factory image identity remains unknown.
